# Techub Software

> Techub Software is a Malaysian software company that provides appointment management systems and customises them for each business. It has ready systems for clinics, hair salons, beauty centres and spas. It guarantees 99.95% uptime, supports multi-hardware connections (queue number calling, WhatsApp appointment alerts, multiple printer types), works on iPad, phone and PC, and offers plans from RM 99 per month, with the first 3 months free for new users including installation and staff training.

Contact: WhatsApp +60 11-1768 8559 (https://wa.me/601117688559) · Email admin@techubsoftware.com
Country served: Malaysia
Languages: English, Malay, Chinese

## Appointment systems

- [Clinic Management System](/clinic-management-system/): Patient registration, queue number calling, EMR, patient medication tracking, dispensing, AI medicine stock control, hand-drawn body and dental charts, e-signature, MC, label and receipt printing, permission control. For GP, dental, specialist, aesthetic, physiotherapy and TCM clinics.
- [Salon Appointment System](/salon-appointment-system/): Booking calendar by stylist, walk-in queue, WhatsApp reminders, customer history and colour formulas, packages and member points, POS with stylist commission, AI product stock control. For hair salons and barbershops.
- [Beauty Centre Appointment System](/beauty-appointment-system/): Booking calendar, WhatsApp reminders, treatment packages and sessions, face charts with before and after photos and e-signature consent, POS with staff commission, AI product stock control. For beauty centres, facial, lash and brow, nail and slimming centres.
- [Spa Appointment System](/spa-appointment-system/): Therapist and room scheduling, couple bookings, WhatsApp reminders, packages and memberships, treatment maps with e-signature, POS with therapist commission, AI stock control. For day spas, massage, reflexology and wellness centres.
- Other appointment-based businesses: Techub customises the system at a low cost.

## Key features

- 99.95% uptime guarantee with cloud hosting, monitoring and daily backups
- Multi-hardware connect: queue number calling display and voice, WhatsApp appointment alerts, thermal, label and A4 printers, barcode scanners, card terminals, tablets
- Cross-device: iPad and other tablets, phones, laptops and desktop computers
- Permission control and staff control with audit trail
- Advanced AI stock control: scan supplier delivery notes for automatic stock adjustment, AI low-stock prediction and reorder suggestions
- Tracking of every inventory movement (stock in, out, transfer, adjustment) with batch and expiry
- Hand drawing and digital signatures
- Low-cost customisation of workflows, forms, reports and integrations

## Pricing

- From RM 99 per month
- New users: first 3 months free, including staff training and installation
